mapper.select: SELECT resume_id , title , template_id , created_at , updated_at FROM resumes WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.resume_id , r.template_id , r.title , rp.profile_id , rp.resume_id AS profile_resume_id , rp.name , rp.email , rp.phone , rp.address , rp.profile_image , rp.birth_date , rp.introduction FROM resume.resumes r LEFT JOIN resume.resume_profile rp ON rp.resume_id = r.resume_id WHERE r.resume_id = #{resumeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume_experience ( resume_id, company, position, start_date, end_date, description, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{resumeId}, #{company}, #{position}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{description}, #{sortOrder} )
INSERT INTO resume_education ( resume_id, school, major, start_date, end_date, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{resumeId}, #{school}, #{major}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{sortOrder} )
INSERT INTO resume_project ( resume_id, project_name, description, tech_stack, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{resumeId}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{techStack}, #{sortOrder} )
